title: Triage a ticket as JSON
system: You triage IT tickets. Output only JSON.
prompt:
Read the ticket and output a JSON object with exactly these keys:
- category: one of hardware, software, network, access, billing
- priority: one of P1, P2, P3, P4
- needs_human: boolean
No other keys. No commentary.

Scale: P1 entire company; P2 a team; P3 one person with workaround; P4 cosmetic.
needs_human is true only for P1/P2 or security/access lockouts.

Ticket from Alex Demo (alex.demo@example.org):
"The Acme Widgets catalog app shows a spelling error on the About page. One person noticed it. Workaround: ignore it. Nothing else is broken."
